runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, set strong pace, headed top of home straight, bumped and lost balance 250m out, well beaten.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，以快步速領放。直路初被超越。二百五十米處被碰撞，失去平衡。所負甚遠。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sluggish start, settled in rear of mid-field, forced to steady on heels 550m out, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置。五百五十米處被迫收慢避開他駒的後蹄。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Sat at the rear, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Bumped start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, last turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide better than midfield, a length back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, 2 wide on turn, angled out after passing 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時被觸碰，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。直路彎走第二疊，跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along into home straight, lost balance 200m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策。二百米處失去平衡。從未能與領先馬匹一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped on terms, settled just off the pace, had every chance from 400M, run ended mid-straight and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居領放馬稍後的位置。自四百米處起一度甚具爭勝機會。直路中段無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Crowded on jumping, sat towards rear, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 躍出時受擠迫，居後列。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 沿途走大外疊。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, moved a little bit closer on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace three wide, keen early, quickly lost place turning into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊，早段搶口。入直路時迅速失位，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Stumbled leaving stalls, raced three wide in rear, keen early, briefly hampered 600m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘時失蹄，居後列，走第三疊。早段搶口。六百米處一度受阻礙。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, keen 800m out, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。八百米處搶口。未能望空直至二百米處。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Mid-field, tight for room 400m out, stayed on final 300m but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。四百米處空位不足。最後三百米保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Raced in touch, chased leaders from top of home straight, stuck to task but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。持續力拼，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 5-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, closed off fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W6W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊，直路上超越部分已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Towards rear of mid-field, pushed along into home straight, stayed on, lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat handy, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居前列。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Mid-field, unable to quicken under pressure over 300m out, stayed on, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。三百米處在催策下未能加速。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sluggish start, rear of mid-field, no real impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置。受催策，但未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈現疲態，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast break, made all, quickened top of home straight, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。直路初加速。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway on bend, ridden top of home straight to challenge leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前。直路初在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, slightly weakened passing 200M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在力策下領放。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至二百米處。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead, weakened final 100m and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路早段加速上前取得領先。最後一百米轉弱，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初墮退至包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Made running, pressed on 400m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 帶頭競跑。四百米處受催策。二百米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W6W) Held up, last and wide into home straight, stayed on final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W6W) 留後。入直路時居包尾位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away awkwardly, quickly recovered to be 3rd tucked in the trail, had difficulty obtaining clear passage over final stages, unable to be fully tested, excusable.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，迅速恢復走勢，居第三位，緊隨對手。末段難以望空。未能全力施為。落敗情有可原。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L, easy lead to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed near 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，領先一又四分一馬位。直路彎前從容領放。直路早段保持佳勢。接近二百米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled handy, traveled comfortably, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策以保持位置。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in mid-field, rail position, angled out under pressure 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。二百米處在催策下向外移出，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Bounded on jumping and lost ground, in rear, still in last pair turning into home straight, left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時向上跳躍及失地，居後列。轉入直路時仍居最後兩位內。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Settled worse than midfield, angled out at the Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎向外移出。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Held up last from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Fast into stride, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 展步迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，被碰撞。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W1W1W) Taken back from gate 10, raced at rear, travelled keenly in the early stages, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W1W1W) 自第十檔出閘後留居後列。早段搶口。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, some headway final 200m, never dangerous.
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘，移入內疊。最後二百米略為追前。從未能構成威脅。
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the outside, difficult to settle throughout, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。沿途難以穩定走勢。直路早段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Was slow away and settled last, failed to keep up with the field throughout, showed limited response when hard ridden final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。沿途未能跟上馬群。末段對力策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide behind midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, no cover on turn, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。中段搶口。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped on jumping, raced towards rear, 2 away from the stands' rail, 6 lengths or so back at 400M, hard ridden 350M, failed to make any progress, finished last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;躍出時發生碰撞，居後列，走外欄第三疊。四百米處落後約六個馬位。三百五十米處受力策，但未能追前。包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched for clear run top of home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初轉換跑線以望空。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, taken wider on bend, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出較外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Wide with leaders from a poor draw, shifted over 1L back to 4th rounding home bend, kept on without quickening after straightening and faded under pressure inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，與領先馬匹並排，走外疊。轉直路彎時墮後逾一個馬位，居第四位。入直路後保持走勢，未能加速。最後一百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Raced in rear of mid-field, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Out the back door early and quickly shifted across behind the field, took a while to wind up, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，早段迅速在馬群之後切入。加速需時。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W4W) Sat in front of midfield, limited response in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W4W) 居中間之前位置。直路上對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, short of room early in home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路早段空位不足。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。居中間之前位置。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, challenged leader 500m out, ran on well to lead narrowly 200m out, crossed by winner 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。五百米處挑戰領放馬。以佳勢上前，二百米處以短距離領先。五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well final 200m but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米走勢良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W6W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, there to turn, made good progress in straight to make frame, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W6W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Sluggish start and crowded leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 200m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。二百米處轉移跑線以望空，保持走勢但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W6W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, a bit closer on turn, very wide into straight, made some progress early in straight, peaked 200M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W6W) 留居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W4W) Sat 4 wide no cover midfield, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 3/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Crowded start, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, peaked on run 500M, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。五百米處未能再增速。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Prominent early, tracking leaders halfway, struggling to hold position final bend, soon weakened.
(Sustained a small abrasion to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small abrasion to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W) 早段居前列，半程時跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎難以保持位置，瞬即轉弱。
（右前腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Shifted out and heavily bumped out of stalls, disputed lead 700m out, ridden top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及與對手互相大力碰撞。七百米處爭奪領先。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前，帶頭。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead on the rail, weakened in the early straight, eased in the 200M. (Unacceptable performance, must trial.) (See incident report.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下取得領先，走內欄。直路早段轉弱。二百米處收慢。（表現難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout, lost balance 900m out, dropped to last place 600m out, widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 沿途走大外疊。九百米處失去平衡。六百米處墮居包尾位置。入直路時走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Shifted out and bumped at start, three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Three wide in mid-field, taken wider on bend, under pressure 600m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎移出更外疊。六百米處受催策。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Shifted out at start, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W5W) Mid-field, very wide throughout, unable to pick up from 300m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置。沿途走大外疊。自三百米處起未能加速。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Dropped in from wide draw, still travelling ok turning into home straight but plenty to do, no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後切入。轉入直路時走勢仍可，但落後頗遠。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2WNIL) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, pulled up near 900M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2WNIL) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。接近九百米處時收停。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, pushed along final bend to chase leaders, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策以追趕領先馬匹，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般及發生觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Held up last, still in rear top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居後列。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide towards rear, 2 wide on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared near 200M, made some progress thereafter until blocked final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居後列，走第三疊。直路彎走第二疊。直路初未能望空。接近二百米處時望空。其後略為追前，最後五十米受阻。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, pushed along halfway, dropped towards rear 300m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。半程時受推策。三百米處墮居後列，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Away well, took narrow lead from 800M, kept on under pressure, headed near 200M and not going the pace of first three late.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速，自八百米處起以短距離領先，在催策下保持走勢。接近二百米處時被超越，末段加速力不及前三名馬匹。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sluggish start and bumped exiting stalls, tracked pace, ridden along 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，與對手互相碰撞。跟隨領放馬，四百米處受催策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped start, sent forward to race prominently, inconvenienced shortly after passing 1300M, 3 wide in the middle stages, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，在催策下上前，居前列。跑過千三米處後不久受妨礙，中段走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Well there and wide without cover, came under pressure to hold place coming onto course proper, dropped out tamely inside final 200M.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;居好位，在離外欄較遠的一方競跑，沒有遮擋。跑離分支直路時在催策下保持位置。最後二百米力竭墮退。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Commenced well, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' side, hard ridden after passing 300M, showed very good response, took the lead approaching 150M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。跑過三百米處後受力策，反應良佳。趨近一百五十米處時領先。末段保持勁勢，輕鬆勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, positioned a length behind the leader, nearer to the middle track, hard ridden after passing 300M, took the lead 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，落後領放馬一個馬位，靠近跑道中央競跑。跑過三百米處後受力策。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Drawn low and raced on outside towards center of track, tracked leaders, hung left under pressure, one paced final 100m, ran out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自內檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，靠近跑道中央競跑。其後在催策下外閃。最後一百米保持同速。末段空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped on jumping, raced in midfield on the stands' rail, 2 to 3 lengths back at 400M, kept on evenly to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走外欄。四百米處落後兩至三個馬位。末段保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Amongst leaders early before settling one back 2-wide, faded from a similar position 300M out and hampered 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 早段居領先馬群中，其後落後一個馬位，走第二疊。三百米處居相若位置，自該處起力竭。一百五十米處受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Led early, headed 700m out, remained prominent, struggled to hold position halfway out, gave ground final 400m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段領先。七百米處被超越。保持居前列。半程時難以保持位置。最後四百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced prominently on leader's quarters, briefly outpaced by that rival 300m out, responded well to come through and lead 100m out, strong to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列，落後領放馬半個馬位。三百米處一度被該駒拋離。其後對催策反應良佳，上前。一百米處取得領先。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Bumped heavily exiting stalls, mid division, checked and blundered 800m out, checked against rail 300m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘時發生大力碰撞，居中間位置。八百米處勒避及失蹄。三百米處沿欄勒避。所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped at the start and sat midfield 4 off the outside fence, did his best work late, looking for a further trip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走外欄第五疊。末段表現最佳，宜增程角逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier but soon taken over 2L back travelling 3-wide without cover, similar into straight, fading when checked 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。二百米處勒避之際力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Never far off the pace, in the 6th spot at 400M less than 2L adrift of leader, failed to muster the speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;沿途距離領放馬不遠。四百米處居第六位，落後領放馬不足兩個馬位。未能加速展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, short of room 250m out to 150m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。二百五十米處至一百五十米處之間空位不足。其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Hurried along early stages from gate 12 and positioned one off the outside rail just behind the leading division, boxed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自第十二檔出閘，早段受催策，居領先馬匹稍後位置，走外欄第二疊。以佳勢力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Shifted out at start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden approaching 300M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)起步時向外斜跑。落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped on jumping, raced in midfield, nearer to the middle track, commenced move after passing 350M, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。跑過三百五十米處後開始上前。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Jumped only fairly, positioned 1-3/4L behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, commenced move after passing 350M, took the lead 250M, headed 150M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘僅屬一般，落後領放馬一又四分三個馬位，走外欄第三疊。跑過三百五十米處後開始上前。二百五十米處取得領先，一百五十米處被超越。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Sat midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。受催策時保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped after the start, from draw 1 stayed close to leaders along the inside, failed to run on passing 250M, weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔起步後被碰撞，保持緊隨領先馬匹，走內疊。跑過二百五十米處時未能追前。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W) Sat last, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled towards the rear, slightly drifted back rounding the home turn, made good late progress final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。轉直路彎時略為墮退。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders, short of room in home straight until 100m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路上空位不足直至一百米處，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Prominent briefly from a wide barrier but soon taken well back approaching first bend, produced good impression under pressure in home straight, made no further impression inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘，一度居前列，但趨近首個彎位時瞬即留後，遙居後列。直路上在催策下追前甚多。一百米處再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Tracked leaders towards centre of course, under pressure 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)跟隨領先馬匹，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon took up running on rail after moderate start, led until headed shortly after straightening, folded up quickly inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，瞬即取得領先，走內欄。領放，直至入直路後不久被超越。最後二百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W) Tracked leading pair, challenged briefly 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。三百米處一度展開挑戰。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight to hold off the challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，力拒對手的挑戰，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, gave ground from the 200M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊。自二百米處起墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, ran on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前，取得領先。走勢強勁，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Ridden along to share outside lead, traveled reasonably well, weakened passing 200M (Disappointing Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 受催策，並排領先，走外疊。走勢不俗。跑過二百米處時轉弱。（表現令人失望。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Broke well from wide draw and across to make running, headed by winner 200m out, no extra final 100m and just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，切入以領放。二百米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米再無餘力，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Prominent and wide early stages, just over 3L back rounding home bend, tired noticeably in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段居前列，走外疊。轉直路彎時落後稍逾三個馬位。直路上已疲態畢呈。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W2W) Began only fairly from the widest draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W2W) 自大外檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, made minor late ground. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the stands' rail, same position in the middle stages, not enough room until 150M, made some progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走外欄。中段居相同位置。空位不足直至一百五十米處。其後略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division towards centre of course, pushed along halfway out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。半程時受推策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact with the right side of its starting gate, raced prominently, difficult to settle in the early stages, made contact 900M, 2 lengths back on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時觸碰閘廂右側，居前列。早段難以穩定走勢。九百米處發生觸碰。直路彎落後兩個馬位。直路早段轉弱，最後一百五十米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat box-seat, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W3W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, hung out rounding the Home Turn, eased down soon after. (Racing Manners Unacceptable, must trial) (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。轉直路彎時外閃，其後瞬即收慢。（走勢難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 1 to 2 lengths back, 2nd on turn, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘一般，居第三位，落後一至兩個馬位。直路彎居第二位。直路早段略為追前，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run to turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off strongly, won by 2 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。入直路後保持走內疊。衝刺強勁，以兩個馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居後列，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但未能增速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W) Pressed forward to soon join the leaders, gradually shifted 2L back to 4th onto first turn, kept on well without quickening from a similar position into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W) 受催策上前，瞬即追上領先馬匹。開始轉首個彎位時逐漸留後兩個馬位，居第四位。入直路時自相若位置保持佳勢，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Commenced well, positioned a length behind the leader, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, weakened inside final furlong.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Held up towards centre of course, pushed along 550m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;留後，靠近跑道中央競跑。五百五十米處受推策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, ridden over 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。三百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped and unbalanced at start, raced in midfield, 3 lengths or so back in the middle stages, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間位置，中段落後約三個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped shortly after start, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, 3 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden after passing 400M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生碰撞，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走外欄第四疊。跑過四百米處後受力策。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Shifted out shortly after start and bumped, raced prominently on the outside, peaked 500M, weakened gradually final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，被碰撞，居前列，走外疊。五百米處未能再增速。最後三百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Shifted out at start and bumped, positioned a length behind the leader, nearer to the middle track, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，落後領放馬一個馬位，靠近跑道中央競跑。自三百五十米處起受力策，但對催策反應僅屬平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat rear, traveled on the rail, minor progress made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, keen mid-race, stayed on for pressure, no threat to winner, passed by runner-up final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。在催策下保持走勢。未能威脅頭馬。最後五十米被亞軍馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Mid-field, headway when badly hampered 250m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置。追前，二百五十米處受嚴重阻礙。未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Crowded and bumped at start, three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。掙扎上前。

raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 香港特區行政長官盃（讓賽）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 1-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 200M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居第三位。轉入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持甚佳走勢。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leader to straight, hit the front over 300M out and soon drew clear, won unchallenged.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 直路前跟隨領放馬。三百米處取得領先，瞬即拋離對手，在未受挑戰下勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader in a race run at fast tempo, cruised to the lead passing 400M, soon quickened away and left his rivals trailing. Won with tremendous ease posting a Hong Kong record 18th successive victory in course record time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，賽事步速甚快。跑過四百米處時上前取得領先。瞬即加速帶離對手。輕鬆取勝，締造十八連勝香港紀錄，並刷新場地紀錄時間。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped on terms, sat just behind the leaders, responded well when asked, kicked clear at the 200M, won easing down.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居領先馬匹稍後位置。對催策反應良佳。二百米處加速帶離對手。在收慢下勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-3/4L turning in, kept on strongly in straight, won very easily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持強勁走勢，從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, travelled strongly, hit the line nicely, easy win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。走勢強勁。衝刺良佳，從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, hit the line strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走勢良佳，末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden early to share the pace, obtained outright lead on rail 1000M out and led until headed inside the 400M, soon faded in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，並排領先。一千米處沿欄單騎領放。四百米處被超越。直路上瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Vied for lead early crossing to rail in front just inside the 1100M, kicked 2L clear briefly rounding home bend before joined into straight and eventually headed inside the 200M. (Riding in home straight questioned.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑過千一米處後切入內欄領放。轉直路彎時加速，一度帶離兩個馬位。入直路時被追上，二百米處被超越。（騎師被查詢在直路上的騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a poor draw, set a fast tempo after obtaining rails run 1200M out, led the field until overhauled inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘瞬即取得領先。千二米處移入內欄後以快步速領放。保持領先直至最後二百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Quickly into stride, led and set fast pace to the straight, headed passing 400M, held 2nd to about 150M, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 展步迅速，取得領先。直路前以甚快步速領放。跑過四百米處時被超越。保持居第二位直至約一百五十米處。接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Began fairly, soon recovered along the rail to just over 2L back in 4th, drifted from 1L off to over 2L back when pace quickened around the bend, gave ground steadily under pressure from approaching home turn.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，瞬即恢復走勢，居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時賽事步速加快，由落後一個馬位墮退至落後逾兩個馬位。自趨近直路彎起在催策下逐漸墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Broke well from a wide draw to soon lead or dispute lead, hit the front briefly just inside the 300M and soon weakened out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，瞬即領放或爭奪領先。跑過三百米處後一度取得領先，瞬即轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well to lead, obtained run close to rail 1100M out, held slender advantage rounding home bend and early in straight, unable to sustain effort and caught inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。千一米處移近內欄。轉直路彎時及直路早段以短距離領先。最後二百米無以為繼及被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, strong run to lead 150m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至三百米處。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。末段被亞軍馬匹追迫，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, switched for clear run 500m out, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, stayed on strongly to challenge winner 200m out, shifted left 100m out, lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持強勁走勢，二百米處挑戰頭馬。一百米處向外斜跑，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, switched for clear run 600m out, pressed on 350m out, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處向外移出以望空，三百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但末段再未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 9, raced behind midfield on outer, very wide into straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled one-out-one-back, commenced move entering straight, hit the front inside the 300M kicking over 1L clear shortly afterwards, held on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居第二疊第二位。入直路時開始上前。三百米處取得領先，其後不久加速帶離逾一個馬位，保持領先至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) From draw 1 settled down in midfield along the fence, held up 400M to 350M, quickened up well when gap opened up, led nearing 150M and kept on late stages to hold off the persistent 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處至三百五十米處受困，出現空位時以佳勢加速，接近一百五十米處時取得領先。末段保持走勢，力拒緊追不捨的亞軍馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Ridden forward to within 2L of pace 2-wide in 4th, travelled keenly on heels of leaders from between the 1100M and 900M, drifted slightly backward to 5th approaching final turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前，居第四位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。千一米處至九百米處之間緊隨領先馬匹，搶口。趨近直路彎時略為墮居第五位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。末段保持穩勢，但未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, took the early lead, headed near 950M, 2nd on turn, retook the lead early in straight, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。接近九百五十米處時被超越。直路彎居第二位。直路初再度取得領先。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled about 6L off the pace in joint 4th 2-wide, in similar position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 並列第四位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時居相若位置。末段持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Settled handy, weakened passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居前列。跑過二百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Away well enough, up with early pace before easing back to sit behind leaders, challenged strongly for the lead from 250M, led nearing 50M but was caught by winner last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘頗佳，早段跟上步速，其後收慢留居領先馬匹之後。自二百五十米處起以勁勢上前挑戰，爭奪領先。接近五十米處時取得領先，但最後一步被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier to share the pace 2-wide, drifted slightly backward rounding home bend before hitting the front just inside the 400M, kicked over 1L clear 200M out only to be swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，並排領先，走第二疊。轉直路彎時略為墮退。跑過四百米處後取得領先。二百米處加速帶離逾一個馬位，僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, short of room against rail top of home straight, checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。直路初走內欄，空位不足。二百米處勒避。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, taken widest into home straight, ran on well to challenge 200m out, tired closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走最外疊。二百米處以佳勢追前以展開挑戰。末段呈疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled about 6L off the pace in 4th on rail, in similar position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening the place-getters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第四位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走內欄。入直路時居相若位置。末段持續力拼，但未能威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled in midfield, came under pressure over 500M out, made no impression in straight but dropped away quickly inside final 150M.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。五百米處受催策。直路上毫無表現，最後一百五十米迅速墮退。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide on pace, weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊。最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield, couldn't go on passing 300M, weakened. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百米處時無以為繼，轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped at the start, from a middle draw crossed towards the stand's side tracking leader, within striking distance always, responded well final 300M only to be out-finished by winner late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自中檔起步時發生碰撞，切向外欄，跟隨領放馬，一直落後不遠。最後三百米對催策反應良佳，末段僅不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, 2 lengths or so back, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled just better than midfield in 4th or 5th on rail, came to challenge under pressure on straightening but could only make modest headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍前的第四或第五位，走內欄。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰，但僅能略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Amongst leaders 3-wide, obtained outright lead on rail about 900M out setting a smart pace, led the field until joined 200M out, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居領先馬群中，走第三疊。約九百米處以甚快步速單騎領放，走內欄。保持領先，直至二百米處被追上，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Tracked pace, ridden 300m out, no extra and lost ground on leaders final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;跟隨領放馬。三百米處受催策。最後二百米再無餘力，落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Wide in prominent position early, obtained 2nd 2-wide over 1000M out, unable to quicken under pressure in home straight and kept on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，走外疊。一千米處進佔第二位，走第二疊。直路上在催策下未能加速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, 3 wide from 900M, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。自九百米處起走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure to hold position middle stages, short of room early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。中段在催策下保持位置。直路初空位不足。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, tracked leader in a steadily run race, hard driven from 300M, kept up the pressure on the winner final 200M but was always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，跟隨領放馬，賽事步速平穩。自三百米處起受力策，最後二百米持續追迫頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began well from the one draw and soon took up running, held narrow advantage most of the way until weakened out of contention over 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，瞬即領先。大部分途程保持領先短距離，直至一百米處轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, not enough room near 200M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，與他駒互相觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時空位不足。其後追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced towards rear on the inside early, angled out after entering the back straight, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，早段居後列，走內疊。進入對面直路後向外移出。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide after entering the back straight, moved closer after passing 900M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘普通，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後走第三疊。跑過九百米處後追近。入直路時落後約兩個馬位，直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Jumped only fairly, raced 3 wide behind midfield, hard ridden after passing 550M, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。跑過五百五十米處後受力策。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, finished off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為追近。衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, challenged up rail from top of home straight, ran on well final 200m to lead close home and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。自直路初起沿欄展開挑戰。最後二百米以佳勢上前，接近終點時取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Out with rest, positioned slightly better than midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 500M, kept on well in straight to take a place, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, made good ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W1W1W) Tracked leaders, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, ran on well but headed by winner 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide after passing 450M, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 150M, hit the front 75M, kept on well to the line and scored. (Dead-Heat)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。跑過四百五十米處後走第三疊。直路初未能望空。趨近一百五十米處時望空。七十五米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。（平頭冠軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W2W3W) Held up last, pushed along and outpaced middle stages, switched widest for clear run 200m out, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W2W3W) 留居包尾位置。中段受推策，但未能跟上步速。二百米處移出最外疊以望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Mid-field, struggling from over 400m out and well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起掙扎上前，所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W5W) Taken back to race at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back, last turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W5W) 留居後列，落後六至七個馬位。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away fast to take the lead, took them along at steady pace middle stages, headed by rivals nearing 200M, no extra final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。中段以平穩步速領放。接近二百米處時被對手超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival from 600M, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。自六百米處起受對手挑戰，直路早段保持佳勢，二百米處未能再增速及被超越，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Shifted in at start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began smartly from gate 13, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked on run 300M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed over 300m out, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。在領放下受追迫。三百米處被超越。瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bounded as stalls opened and lost ground, raced in rear, forced to steady on heels 900m out, tight of room 350m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 開閘時向上跳躍及失地，居後列。九百米處被迫收慢避開對手的後蹄。三百五十米處空位不足。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) In rear after slow start, ridden 400m out, some late inroads, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。四百米處受催策。末段略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Never better than midfield, found nothing in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 從未超越中間位置。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Sat towards rear, traveled fairly, minor progress made when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走勢一般。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and bumped, raced towards rear on the inside, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W4W5W) Raced towards the rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W4W5W) 居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W5W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, very wide turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Have a heart condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(3W3W3W5W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路初對催策毫無反應。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心臟有問題。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W2W1W1W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 800m out, forced to steady 200m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W2W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處受催策。二百米處被迫收慢。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Held up last from wide draw, late headway into mid-division, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。末段追前至中間位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W1W1W) Sat rear, not much response when asked, no contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W1W1W) 居後列。對催策反應不大。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always in last few on rail, saved ground turning in for home, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途居最後數位之內，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well from a poor draw settling in midfield 3-wide without cover, remained in a similar position to straight and could find no extra under pressure.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路前仍居相若位置，在催策下再無餘力。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, dropped to last pair into home straight, strong run between horses from 300m out, edged ahead close home, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時墮居最後兩位之內。自三百米處起在馬匹之間衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out 400M, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Made running, raced keenly, drew away early stages, headed by winner 600m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑，搶口。早段帶離對手。六百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, angled out approaching 700M, 4 wide turning in, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。趨近七百米處時向外移出。入直路時走第四疊。末段衝刺良佳，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W3W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out 500M, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide from 850M, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自八百五十米處起走第三疊。中段略為追近。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, slightly improved after passing 600M, 2nd turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過六百米處後略為推進。入直路時居第二位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, headed 250M, kept on well until approaching 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。二百五十米處被超越，保持佳勢直至趨近五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, challenged the leader 600M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。六百米處挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, failed to respond under whip (See Incident Report).
(Blood at the right nostril.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。對鞭策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右邊鼻孔有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled midfield, one pace to the finish (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, weakened and faded in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。直路上轉弱及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 1100M, 3 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made no impression in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。跑過千一米處後略為追近，直路彎落後三個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure 700m out, switched widest in home straight, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策。直路上移至最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure from 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起受催策。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled towards rear, made some ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the inside, 8 lengths back turning in, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後八個馬位。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out 800M, made contact 700M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。八百米處向外移出。七百米處發生觸碰。入直路時落後約四個馬位，末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Commenced well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no daylight until final 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。未能望空直至一百五十米處。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, had difficulty obtaining clear running until 200M, could not make up ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。二百米處前難以望空。末段未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat on pace, weakened and faded in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居前列。直路上轉弱及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away and lost ground, raced in rear, still plenty to do top of home straight, strong run final 200m but just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢及失地，居後列。直路初仍落後甚遠。最後二百米走勢強勁，但僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run 200m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百米處望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded at start, settled in mid-field, pushed along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。五百米處受推策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed by winner top of home straight, dropped away quickly, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑，在領放下受追迫。直路初被頭馬超越。迅速墮退，落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, switched out entering the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, raced at tail, still last turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置。入直路時仍居包尾位置。直路上移出外疊。衝刺良佳。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, found rail 1050M, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。一千零五十米處移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled towards rear in 10th or 9th, made no impression in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列第九或第十位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Travelled keenly just over 2L back in 6th, drifted slightly further off the pace around home bend, shied away from horse 250M out, kept on steadily without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居第六位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，搶口。轉直路彎時略為墮後，落後領放馬更遠。二百五十米處斜跑避開他駒。保持穩勢，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, hard ridden from 450M, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自四百五十米處起受力策。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W5W5W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure 550m out, stayed on steadily to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W5W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處受催策。保持穩勢，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on very well in straight, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持甚佳走勢，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure to hold position final bend, crowded and checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎在催策下保持位置。二百米處受擠迫及勒避，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W3W) Tracked pace, stuck to task under pressure but lacked pace to challenge winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W3W) 跟隨領放馬。受催策力拼，但速度不足以挑戰頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W5W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, angled out 450M, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W5W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。四百五十米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 13, took the lead, led by a 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自最第十三檔出閘迅速，取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, dropped to midfield on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎墮居中間位置。直路初未能再增速，最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced better than midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 1100M, 2nd in the middle stages, outpaced early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過千一米處後略為追近。中段居第二位。直路早段被拋離。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, 4-1/2L back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide without cover, hung in final 200m, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，墮後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米內閃。保持走勢，但未能加速以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Raced wide towards rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能增速以展開挑戰。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the outside, 6 lengths or so back, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W2W3W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 1100M, slightly improved in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。千一米處向外移出，中段略為推進。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W2W4W) Crowded and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 450m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W2W4W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。四百五十米處向外移出推進。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, 7 lengths back turning in, difficult to obtain clear run early in straight, made some headway thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路早段難以望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W3W3W) Slowly away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide from 800M, 4 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自八百米處起走第三疊。直路彎落後四個馬位。入直路時走大外疊，衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, 3-1/2L back turning in, closed off well to take 3rd without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。中段略為追近。入直路時落後三個半馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Across to press leader, under pressure 500m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。五百米處受催策。保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well from the one draw niggling along early, gradually settled about 2L back in 3rd from over 800M out, obtained a clear run over 200M out but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段受催策。自八百米處起逐漸居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。二百米處望空，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 12, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Made running, challenged 300m out, saw off that rival after sustained battle, headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處受挑戰。持續力拼，力拒對手。接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, headed 100M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再加速。一百米處被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Fast to jump, prominent one off the rail, kept finding plenty to the line when challenged by the late swooper.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。末段受衝刺強勁的對手挑戰時保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, weakened quickly final 300m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受催策。最後三百米迅速轉弱，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, driven along to chase leader 450m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策以追趕領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced in 2nd, a length back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Away in line, settled down midfield 4-5Ls off leader, failed to respond under pressure 500M, gave ground soon after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。五百米處對催策毫無反應。入直路後瞬即墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped and lost balance out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, ridden 300m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策，最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat at the rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居後列。從未參與競逐。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Cosmic Force from Thirty Rock, a daughter of Rock Of Gibraltar. Horses by the same sire include Tourbillon Golfer and King Alloy. This fellow was given seven trials in Hong Kong for four wins and one placing. He shared the lead and won under pressure, by a short-head, over 1200m AWT at Conghua on August 20. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fourth under slight pressure, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on August 30. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「星間力量」(Cosmic Force)之後，在港同父馬包括「飛輪霸」及「皇金合」等駒，生母出自「直布羅山」(Rock Of Gibraltar)。抵港後七次試閘得四勝一位。8月20日出試從化泥地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下以短馬頭位之先勝出。最近8月30日出試田草1000米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。潛質不俗，初出預計會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled just behind the lead, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
