Pace Slow; (1W1W) Ridden early to be up with the pace, gradually shifted over 2L back in 5th home bend, angled off rail for a run on straightening but no clear run until about 200M out, quickened well late to snatch 2nd close to finish.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策以緊隨領放馬。直路彎逐漸墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時移離內欄取位，但未能望空直至約二百米處。末段加速良佳。接近終點時跑獲亞軍。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, just one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。末段僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sluggish start, three wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, weakened over 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W) Keen in mid-field, allowed to stride forward out wide and led 600m out, headed over 150m out, fading when tight for room closing stages.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間位置，搶口。獲許展步上前，走外疊。六百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被超越。末段受緊迫之際力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled well back from a wide barrier, keen when tempo slackened approaching first bend, snuck closer to within 5L of pace on rail in 11th into straight, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後。趨近首個彎位時在步速減慢之際搶口。入直路時沿欄追近至第十一位，落後領放馬不逾五個馬位。末段追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Broke well before settling in rear of midfield, became worse in 8th rounding home bend, ran on well under pressure near the centre of the track to claim 3rd closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時居後列第八位。末段靠近跑道中央競跑，在催策下以佳勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Settled just worse than midfield, ran on steadily inside final 250M but without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間稍後位置。最後二百五十米以穩勢追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Close up on rail early, carried backward losing a couple of lengths onto first turn, midfield rounding home bend but snuck back up after straightening, making good ground when running into heels and checked 150M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。開始轉首個彎位時墮後數個馬位。轉直路彎時居中間位置。入直路後再次上前，追前甚多，一百五十米處靠近對手後蹄時勒避，其後從未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, moved smoothly into contention 400m out, stayed on well final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處順勢上前展開挑戰。最後三百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, good headway to challenge leader top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。以佳勢上前，直路初挑戰領放馬。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, made good progress when asked near 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走勢尚可。接近一百五十米處時在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Gradually taken back to last few after beginning from a wide barrier, one of the widest into home straight, inconvenienced for a stride just inside the 300M, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留居最後數位之內。入直路時走最外疊。三百米處一度受妨礙。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide, 2 lengths or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, checked near the 150M, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。接近一百五十米處時勒避。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W4W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 500M, very wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Raced wide from high draw, improved to track pace before halfway, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘，走外疊。半程前推進上前以跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W4W) Rear of mid-field, taken wide and forward move turning into home straight, sustained run to lead 150m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W4W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時移出外疊及上前。持續上前，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, settled in front of midfield, raced wide, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W5W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, commenced move 450M, very wide turning in, finished off very strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W5W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲。接近終點時領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, made steady progress in the straight until severely checked after 150M, never tested afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上穩步追前，跑過一百五十米處後大力勒避。其後從未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well travelling one back on the rail, baulked for a run on rail until forced to switch 150M out, responded well to hit the front briefly before pipped at the post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後一個馬位，走內欄。沿欄受困，直至一百五十米處被迫轉換跑線。末段對催策反應良佳，一度進佔領先位置，直至在終點僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Chased the leader, raced wide throughout, gave ground in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 追趕領放馬，沿途走外疊。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (3W2W) Tracked leader, carried left 300m out, unable to stay with winner final 200m but stayed on to hold second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(3W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處被帶向外跑。最後二百米未能跟上頭馬，但保持走勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began well, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader on rail, same position on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位，走內欄。直路彎居相同位置。末段以佳勢衝刺，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, run peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, 3/4L back turning in, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後四分三馬位。三百米處取得領先。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leader, unable to keep tabs on that rival from 300m out, stuck to task to hold second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起未能跟上領放馬。持續力拼，保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, inconvenienced near 900M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, not enough room early in straight, cleared 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時受妨礙。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路初空位不足，一百五十米處望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, moved closer on turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well to the line, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點。末段僅能力拒對手挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead final 50m, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 8 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後約八個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, taken wider on bend, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎移出更外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W5W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W5W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位，走第二疊。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sat towards the rear, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, left behind home straight.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。直路上被拋離。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Towards rear, short-lived headway 300m out, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。三百米處一度追前。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W5W) Trapped wide with no cover throughout from gate 11, commencing forward move from 700M, had tough run and unable to finish off (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W5W) 自第十一檔出閘。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。自七百米處起開始上前。耗力太多，末段未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Towards rear, good headway 300m out, no danger to winner but stayed on well to take second final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。三百米處追前甚多。最後一百米保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, held up at the top of the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。早段搶口。直路初受困，末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W) Sat midfield, raced wide and without cover, gave ground quickly in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Settled midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, responded nicely when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the inside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sluggish start, pushed up to race in rear of mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 300m, in contention and every chance final 150m, bumped by rival late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，受推策上前，居中間之後位置。最後三百米在催策下保持走勢。最後一百五十米持續拼鬥，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段被對手碰撞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W4W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Crowded start, raced at tail, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居包尾位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W2W2W1W) Soon taken well back from a poor draw, remained in last few before sneaking closer on rail turning in for home, ran on steadily under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W2W2W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。轉直路彎時仍居最後數位之內，入直路時沿欄追近。在催策下保持穩勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, bumped 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。一百米處被碰撞，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Settled midfield, no clear run at the early Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初未能望空。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Ridden to soon recover from moderate start to 5th within 3L of pace, drifted over 4L back when tempo increased at about 800M, slightly further back in 6th 500M out, fought on steadily in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策，瞬即恢復走勢，居第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。約八百米處步速加快時墮退，落後逾四個馬位。五百米處略為墮居第六位。直路上持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Towards rear on rail, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, just over 4L back into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。入直路時落後稍逾四個馬位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Crowded soon after start, recovered to take up mid-field position, headway 200m out, flattened out final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步後瞬即受擠迫，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。二百米處上前。最後五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered to 10th on rail and then 9th 800M out, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居第十位，走內欄。八百米處居第九位。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下以穩勢上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Moderately away from gate 9, taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, moved a bit closer after passing 450M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 自第九檔出閘普通，留居後列，走第二疊。跑過四百五十米處後略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前，獲得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover early stages, improved to track leaders two wide with cover 600m out, effort 400m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 早段跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處推進以跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊，有遮擋。四百米處發力，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Caught wide no cover chasing leaders, had no extra final 200M and weakened out of contention. (Jockey - obliged to make use early stages to hold a forward position.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米再無餘力，轉弱，再無爭逐機會。（騎師表示，他須於早段催策坐騎以佔取前列位置。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, 3 wide, there to turn, kept on very well in straight, always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持甚佳走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Wide early, improved to track leaders out wide without cover 800m out, effort 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 早段走外疊。推進以跟隨領先馬匹，八百米處走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處發力。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide after passing 600M, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。跑過六百米處後走第二疊，入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, ran on well when asked, won going away, smartly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。在催策下走勢良佳，帶離對手，以佳勢取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden forward from widest draw and across to make running, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，切入以領放。一百米處被超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a steady pace, gained 1L advantage shortly after straightening, unable to sustain effort and outsprinted inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 瞬即以平穩步速領放。入直路後不久領先一個馬位。最後一百米無以為繼，被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From wide draw went forward to chase leader along the 2-path, didn't finish as well as his rivals from 300M, weakened 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，上前追趕領放馬，走第二疊。自三百米處起衝刺不及對手。一百五十米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from draw 1, set pace and led the field until 300M, battled on latter stages to finish a non- threatening 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，以偏快步速領放直至三百米處。末段力拼，取得第四名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, tight for room turning into home straight, clear run 300m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時受緊迫。三百米處望空。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked pace, moved smoothly into contention top of home straight, sticking to task, lost second on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初順勢上前挑戰。持續力拼。過終點時失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Sat midfield 3 wide, angled out in the Straight, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上向外移出。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Chased leader, under pressure 550m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 追趕領放馬。五百五十米處受催策。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until final 50M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至最後五十米。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) A little awkward away and threw the head about, over-raced in the early and middle stages, momentarily held up at the top of home straight, ran on fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘略為笨拙，將頭兩邊擺動。早段及中段搶口。直路初一度受困。末段在催策下走勢不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Under pressure to press leader, struggled to hold position from 500m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 受催策，追迫領放馬。自五百米處起難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled in joint 4th just over 3L off the pace on rail, drifted further back to 5th onto first bend, did not find much room behind runners early in straight, produced good late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 並列第四位，落後領放馬稍逾三個馬位，走內欄。開始轉首個彎位時進一步墮後至第五位。直路早段在對手之後空位不足。最後一百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, similar position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, ran on nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。走勢良佳，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (3W1W1W) Started well and across from wide draw to make running, headed 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(3W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，切入領放。一百五十米處被超越，其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked approaching 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段保持佳勢。趨近二百米處時未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled one back in 2nd after beginning from a wide draw, came under pressure in home straight and overhauled inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路上受催策。最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Jumped awkwardly but travelled keenly in front narrowly, obtained rails run onto home bend but lost advantage narrowly into straight, re-gained lead under pressure inside the 200M only to be swamped final few strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 出閘笨拙，搶口，但以短距離領放。開始轉直路彎時移入內欄，但入直路時失去領先優勢，以短距離落後。二百米處在催策下重奪領先，僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced prominently on the inside, allowed rival to cross near 700M, 1-1/2L back turning in, finished off strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居前列，走內疊。接近七百米處時讓對手過頭。入直路時落後一個半馬位。衝刺強勁，接近終點時領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Waited with in rear, driven along and some headway early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路早段受催策，略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped at the start, from draw 10 dropped back to near last, had some work to do 400M, finished off nicely to take 5th. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自第十檔起步時發生碰撞，墮居接近包尾位置。四百米處稍為落後。衝刺良佳，取得第五名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield, traveled only fairly, gave ground quickly in the Straight (Must BT).
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。直路上迅速墮退。（必須試閘及格。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced behind midfield on inner, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear, 7 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Checked shortly after start dropping to tail-end, trailed the field until snuck up one closer home turn, effort short-lived.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久勒避，墮居包尾位置。尾隨馬群，直路彎追近一個馬位，但衝刺短暫。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Tarzino from Ristretto, a daughter of Makfi. Horses by the same sire include Sure Joyful and Daily Trophy. This fellow was given five trials in Hong Kong for one placing. He sat not far behind the pace and finished third under pressure, beaten by 13L-1/2s, over 1200m AWT in Conghua on August 20. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished eighth under pressure, beaten by 6-1/2Ls, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on August 30. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「大捷龍」(Tarzino)之後，在港同父馬包括「得意佳作」及「日日獎」等駒，生母出自「馬勁飛」(Makfi)。抵港後五次試閘一次上名。8月20日出試從化泥地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬13.5個馬位。最近8月30日出試田草1000米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第八名，落後頭馬6.5個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began from a wide barrier, took up running after first 100M and rails run 900M out onto first turn, steadied up the pace rounding home bend, led until swamped when no extra inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘。跑了一百米後進佔領先位置。九百米處首次轉彎時走內欄。轉直路彎時減慢步速。末段領放，直至最後五十米再無餘力，被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Slowly away, wide towards rear, hung left halfway, very wide turning into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走外疊。半程時外閃。入直路時走大外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat on pace, weakened inside 150M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Away with them, raced prominently, 2 wide, same position on turn, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed 150M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。三百米處取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on without threatening top 3.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持走勢，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Caught 3-wide without cover chasing leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M and weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began awkwardly, trailed the field to straight, widest turning in for home, only ran past well-beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙。直路前尾隨馬群。轉入直路時走最外疊。僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Took up the front-running position early and posted some very fast sectionals, folded up quickly over final stages and had to pay the price.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段取得領先，以甚快步速領放。耗力太多，末段迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled midfield, raced wide throughout, weakened passing 250M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。沿途走外疊。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) With leaders, ceded position to travel one-out-one-back in 4th onto home bend, kept on in straight until faded inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 早段居領先馬匹之間。開始轉直路彎時墮居第二疊第二位，即馬群中的第四位。直路上保持走勢，直至最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced behind midfield on the inside early, 2 wide and moved a bit closer after passing 1000M, 3Ls back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，早段居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過一千米處後略為追近，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能望空。二百米處望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped shortly after start, settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quicken in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the stands' side, inconvenienced near 650M, 3 to 4 lengths back at 400M, kept on one-paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，靠近外欄競跑。接近六百五十米處時受妨礙。四百米處落後三至四個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。未能望空直至三百米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, gave ground final 200M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield, 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Shifted out at start and made heavy contact, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相大力觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路初對催策反應平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Wide in mid-field, brief effort 400m out, soon flattened out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處一度發力，瞬即洩氣，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled well back from a poor draw, never a danger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後遙居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) In rear after sluggish start, still in rear top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢後居後列。直路初仍居後列。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Sat at the rear, closed off nicely, run peaked final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居後列。衝刺良佳。最後七十五米未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back, finished off well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, keen, tight for room 300m out, no extra final 200m.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，搶口。三百米處受緊迫。最後二百米再無餘力。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (4W4W) Jumped with them, raced at rear on the outside, 8 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，落後約八個馬位，走外疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Raced in mid-division, ridden top of home straight, ran on well but no threat to winner, challenged for second but just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。走勢良佳，但未能威脅頭馬，爭奪亞軍，但僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on at the same pace in the early straight when asked, weakened in the last furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路早段在催策下保持同速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield early, found rail near 800M, angled out after passing 500M, unable to obtain clear run until 150M, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Made a respiratory noise during the running of the race.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Made a respiratory noise during the running of the race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞。接近八百米處時移入內欄。跑過五百米處後向外移出。未能望空直至一百五十米處，保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）
（在陣上發出呼吸聲。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，入直路時走勢暢順。走勢良佳，最後五十米取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W) Out with rest, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, closed off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made contact with the gate on jumping, sat rear, made some ground from behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂，居後列。末段自後列略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 600m out, ridden top of home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路初受催策。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, keen middle stages, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。中段搶口。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Settled midfield on the rail, held up in the Straight, unable to be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上受困，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven 450m out, unable to pick up for pressure, eased when detached 150m out.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。四百五十米處受催策，但未能加速。 一百五十米處被拋離時收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W3W) Settled worse than midfield, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace, three wide, struggling to quicken when tight for room 300m out, weakened after.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。三百米處在受緊迫之際難以加速。其後轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W5W) Sluggish start, three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W5W) 起步緩慢，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) A fraction slow away, sat a tad worse than midfield hugging the rail, failed to muster speed, quickly beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。末段未能加速，迅速洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) In rear after blundering leaving stalls, keen, driven along into home straight, some late headway, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 躍出時失蹄，居後列，搶口。入直路時受催策。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon led setting steady pace in front under 10lb claimer, headed 350M but refused to give in, fought bravely to the line for a respectable 4th .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 由獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎，瞬即取得領先，以平穩步速領放。三百五十米處被超越，但奮力頑抗，力拼至終點，取得第四名，表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Soon led under 10lb claimer, set slow pace early stages before quickening up halfway, was strongly pressed by eventual 2nd final 250M but held on bravely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 由獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎，瞬即領放。早段以慢步速領放。半程時加速。最後二百五十米受亞軍馬匹以勁勢追迫，但力保勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) In front early stages but was restrained to race behind leader on settling, couldn't find extra gear to challenge passing 350M, faded final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段居前列，其後受約束以跟隨領放馬。跑過三百五十米處時未能加速以展開挑戰，末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front from 500m out, stayed on well in home straight but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。自五百米處起在領放下受追迫。直路上保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Led early stages, narrowly headed 2-wide 800M out, faded further out of contention inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段領放。八百米處被超越，落後短距離，走第二疊。最後三百米力竭，進一步墮退，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled comfortably, closed off strongly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢暢順。末段衝刺強勁。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, nothing extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後仍走內疊，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in rear, ridden top of home straight, didn't get best of runs final 100m when trying to improve, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路初受催策。最後一百米在嘗試推進之際取位不太暢順，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 500M, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, closed off well to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。衝刺良佳，獲得季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Travelled in last few, saved ground rounding home bend but angled out for a run entering straight, baulked until switched out for a run 350M out, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時走內疊節省腳程，但入直路時向外移出取位。受困，三百五十米處向外移出取位。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked pace against rail, had to wait for run turning into home straight, switched inside for clear run 300m out, strong run final 200m to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處移入內疊以望空。最後二百米衝刺強勁，終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Jumped on terms, held up in mid-division 3-wide, brought widest to challenge on straightening but ran on only fairly. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，留居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時移出最外疊以展開挑戰，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, no daylight until approaching final 150M, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier, lost cover 3-wide one back over 1000M out, quickened to hold some chance early in straight but could only keep on at the same pace inside final 200M and swamped for a placing late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。一千米處落後一個馬位，走第三疊，失去遮擋。直路早段加速，一度頗具勝望，但最後二百米僅能保持同速。末段被超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Broke well before settling just off the pace in 2nd on rail, angled out to challenge turning in for home holding every chance before finding no extra inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，其後居領放馬稍後的第二位，走內欄。轉入直路時向外移出以展開挑戰。一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, quickened early to lead 250m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Away well, raced slightly better than midfield but trapped wide, no cover throughout, finished off well, just beaten by a narrow margin. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。衝刺良佳，僅以短距離落敗。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Shifted out abruptly at the start, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, hit the front 300M, challenged by rival from 150M, bumped near 100M, kept on well and scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步時急促向外斜跑，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百米處取得領先。自一百五十米處起受對手挑戰。接近一百米處時與對手互相碰撞。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Made running, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, in control final 100m, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 帶頭。直路初加速，瞬即控制大局。最後一百米穩操勝券。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked pace, quickened to lead 150m out, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。其後加速，一百五十米處領先，走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in last few after a moderate start and waited with in 8th some 6L off the pace, commenced move approaching home turn and finished off the race well inside final 150M, did beset work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘普通，其後居後列第八位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，留力候上。趨近直路彎時開始上前。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Crowded at start, raced in touch with leaders, followed runner-up through 600m out, hung in but ran on strongly to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。末段內閃，但衝刺強勁。接近終點時取得領先，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。走勢良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 wide turning in, kept on very well in straight, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位。入直路時走第二疊。直路上保持甚佳走勢，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 1000M, 1-1/2L back turning in, showed good response in straight, challenged the leader 150M, bumped 100M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過一千米處後追近。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處挑戰領放馬。一百米處與對手互相碰撞。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Shifted in and heavily bumped out of stalls, mid division, under pressure on bend to chase leaders, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相大力碰撞，居中間位置。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。未能望空直至一百米處。保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Reserved in midfield 5Ls off the steady pace, quickened up well in the straight to be challenging for the lead, in front near 150M but couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 留居中間位置，落後步速平穩的領放馬五個馬位。直路上以佳勢加速，爭奪領先。接近一百五十米處時取得領先，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Travelled in midfield 6-7Ls off the pace middle stages, in 4th spot throughout, couldn't improve position final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。中段落後領放馬六至七個馬位。沿途居第四位。最後四百米未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in second half of the field 4-5Ls off the pace, responded fairly on straightening and was unable to make ground on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。入直路時對催策反應一般，未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, taken wide 300m out, quickened well to pass rivals and lead 150m out, kept going to line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處移出外疊。加速良佳，超越對手，一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, mid division, under pressure 400m out, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與一駒互相碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處受催策。以佳勢上前，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Moderately away, happy to let the speed go in midfield one off, 5Ls or so off the leader turning for home, let down sharply centre of track but just unable to pip the winner bob of the heads.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 出閘普通，放棄爭奪領先，居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時落後領放馬約五個馬位。末段在跑道中央以勁勢上前，但在叮噹馬頭下僅敗於頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W1W1W1W) Average to begin, raced slightly better than midfield on inner, saved ground on turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 100M, kept on very well, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W1W1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間稍前位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Quickly into stride, up with early pace before sitting back to track leaders, run ended 250M then weakened rapidly to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 展步迅速，早段跟上步速，其後留後，跟隨領先馬匹。二百五十米處無以為繼，其後迅速轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped awkwardly, raced in midfield but never far off from leaders, stayed on reasonably well final 300M. Not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘笨拙，居中間位置，但從未遠離領先馬匹。最後三百米保持頗佳走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Driven forward form draw 10 to take up running, shook off rivals early straight to open up 2.5L lead mid-straight, caught by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自第十檔出閘後受催策上前領放。直路早段擺脫對手，直路中段帶離兩個半馬位。接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in at start, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, challenged the leaders early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路初挑戰領先馬匹。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sped forward to take up running, raced keenly entering back straight, opened up a big lead before steadying the pace home turn, ran on again final 200M to hold pursuing rivals at bay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 加速上前帶頭。進入對面直路時搶口。遙遙領先，其後在直路彎減慢步速。最後二百米再度上前，力拒緊追的對手掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 自第十一檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W2W2W) Slightly slow out, raced behind midfield on the outside, sent forward after passing 1200M, took the lead 900M, led by 3/4L in the middle stages, headed 400M, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W2W2W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走外疊。跑過千二米處後受催策上前。九百米處取得領先。中段領先四分三馬位。四百米處被超越。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, across to press leader, struggled to hold position from 600m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，切入以追迫領放馬。自六百米處起難以保持位置。所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to hold position early stages, angled out 500m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。早段未能保持位置。五百米處向外移出。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Stumbled leaving stalls and bumped shortly after start, in rear, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, ran on well to move into second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時失蹄，其後不久與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初移出外疊以望空。以佳勢追前，接近終點時進佔第二位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled down behind leaders along the fence, came through strongly to challenge for the lead 250M, all out final stages to beat off the persistent runner up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。以勁勢上前，二百五十米處爭奪領先。末段全力拼鬥，擊敗緊追不捨的亞軍馬匹掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 1 went forward to track leader along the fence, fought well in the straight, tried had final 200M but was always held by the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走內欄。直路上以佳勢力拼。最後二百米力拼，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W) Widest throughout, dropped to rear 800m out, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W) 沿途走最外疊。八百米處墮居後列。入直路時在最外疊受推策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced prominently, good progress to press leader 700m out, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列。七百米處追前甚多，追迫領放馬。二百米處帶離對手兩個馬位。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leader, driven 500m out to chase leader, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。五百米處受催策，追趕領放馬。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide, a length back, 3 wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run approaching 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初略為追前。趨近一百米處時未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Raced prominently, outpaced by leaders final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列。最後二百米被領先馬匹拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, bumped over the concluding stages, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 在催策下取得領先，走勢暢順。末段與對手互相碰撞。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Checked after the start, ended up near last much further back than usual, gave only limited response on straightening. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步後勒避，其後居於遠較往常為後的接近包尾位置。入直路時對催策反應僅屬平平。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival from 600M, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前帶頭。自六百米處起受對手挑戰。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Raced 3-wide at the rear, unable to make up ground in the straight. (Jockey was advised he had made error of judgement by not improving position in early stages to avoid racing wide and without cover.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路上未能追前。（小組告誡騎師，他於早段未有讓坐騎上前以免坐騎在沒有遮擋下走外疊屬判斷錯誤。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 250m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處向外移出以望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, some headway final bend, widest into home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。入直路時走最外疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速上前展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Settled down 2-wide in midfield, briefly held up 300M, closed off well when a gap opened up but proved no match for winner's pace late stages. Got up for 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。三百米處一度受困。出現空位時以佳勢衝刺，但末段加速力不及頭馬。接近終點時進佔第二位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Shared 6th on rail about 3L off pace early, gained closer to just over 2L back in 5th in slackened tempo home bend, switched out for a tight run just inside the 300M gaining 3rd 50M out. (Questioned for his riding in straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 早段並居第六位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎在步速減慢下追近至第五位，落後稍逾兩個馬位。跑過三百米處後向外移出至窄位。最後五十米進佔第三位。（騎師被查詢有關他在直路上的騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) In midfield along the fence, travelled well into straight but had to wait for a run, shifted lane 250M to continue into clear running before seeing it out strongly to win by 1.5L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時走勢良佳，但須等待空位出現。二百五十米處轉換跑線以繼續望空，其後衝刺強勁，以一個半馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader 2-wide, came under pressure to challenge on straightening gaining upper hand just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰。跑過一百米處後佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Raced prominently, upsides leader entering home straight, unable to stay with that rival, stuck to task, closed up final 100m but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居前列。入直路時與領放馬並跑，其後未能跟上該駒。持續力拼，最後一百米追近，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (3W2W) Well there 3-wide early obtaining 2-wide position onto home bend, gradually faded under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(3W2W) 早段居好位，走第三疊。開始轉直路彎時走第二疊。最後二百米在催策下逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked leaders, ridden along to hold position 800m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。八百米處在催策下保持位置。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W) Recovered to first few briefly after moderate start, gradually taken back from the 1000M to be over 3L back in midfield at about 700M out, made short-lived progress early in straight but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W) 起步一般，其後恢復走勢，一度進佔前列。自一千米處起逐漸留後，約七百米處居中間位置，落後逾三個馬位。直路初一度發力，但最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Slowly away, recovered to race in mid-division, checked briefly halfway, ridden along 400m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘緩慢，恢復走勢，居中間位置。半程時一度勒避。四百米處受催策，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on nicely, just no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持佳勢，僅未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival on turn, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎與對手並排領先。二百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, driven along 400m out, weakened quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Prominent early, 3-wide without cover rounding first bend, just over 2L off the pace in 4th in back straight, gave ground under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 早段居前列。首次轉彎時走第三疊，沒有遮擋。對面直路上居第四位，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。最後二百米在催策下墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped on jumping, ended up racing behind mid-division, failed to respond when driven along 400M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。四百米處對催策毫無反應。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Across to press leader early stages, tracked leaders 800m out, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, dropped away quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 早段切入以追迫領放馬。八百米處跟隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速，其後迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders against rail, driven 500m out, unable to pick up for pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處受催策。自三百米處起受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W4W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W4W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 500M, no clear run early in straight, found daylight 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自五百米處起走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，二百米處望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped back from wide draw, settled near the rear and 6Ls off leader 400M, made some progress and wasn't beaten far at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居後列。四百米處落後領放馬六個馬位。末段略為追前，過終點時所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, some headway on bend, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎略為追前。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Settled back in the field 5-6Ls off leaders, pace very slow for the first half of the race, failed to make up ground in the straight. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居後列，落後領先馬匹五至六個馬位。賽事前半段步速非常緩慢。直路上未能追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Raced in rear, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列。直路初向外移出以望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat off pace on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Ridden forward along rail to reach within 3L of pace in 5th, drifted slightly backward to 6th rounding home bend despite niggling along, soon weakened in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前，居第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位，走內欄。儘管受催策，轉直路彎時稍為墮後至第六位。直路上瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, every chance 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處甚具爭勝機會。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Driven forward from a poor draw holding prominent positions well off the rail, came to join race leader briefly onto first turn, but unable to quicken to challenge from 1L joint 2nd into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，居前列位置，離欄競跑。開始轉首個彎位時一度追上領放馬。入直路時並居第二位，落後一個馬位，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead 950M, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on very well in straight and scored.
(Jockey dropped whip passing 250M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列。九百五十米處取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，掄元。
（騎師於跑過二百五十米處時跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於跑過二百五十米處時跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat one pace 2 wide, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Not the quickest out, settled off pace on the rail, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘並非最快，居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide behind midfield, closed off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Bumped leaving stall, held up, plenty to do top of home straight, angled out at 300m line, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留後。直路初落後甚遠。三百米處向外移出。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, held up, headway up inside rail over 300m out, no further impression final 100m, short of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，留後。三百米處沿欄追前。最後一百米再無表現。末段空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slow to begin, sat last, stayed on well late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in 4th about 2L off the pace, commenced move between runners entering home straight but unable to quicken under pressure throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居第四位，落後領放馬約兩個馬位。入直路時在馬匹之間開始發力，但沿途在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway onto heels of leaders bend, one paced under pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前緊隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Settled in midfield near the rail, saved ground turning in for home, improved under pressure to reach distant 2nd over 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，靠近內欄競跑。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程，在催策下上前，一百五十米處進佔第二位，落後頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, ran on strongly for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。走勢強勁，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W5W) Began awkwardly, raced keenly in a position towards the rear, swung wide for home before closing off the race mildly. (Jockey - may not have run out a strong 1400M.)
(Blood in trachea and respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，搶口。入直路時移出外疊，其後衝刺普通。（騎師表示，坐騎或未能在千四米途程上交出好表現。）
（氣管有血及有呼吸毛病。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, steadied near 850M, wider turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。接近八百五十米處時收慢。入直路時走較外疊。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in touch, headway to challenge 200m out, every chance and led briefly final 100m, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。二百米處追前以展開挑戰。最後一百米一度取得領先，末段保持走勢，已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along 700m out, short of room from 350m out to 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。七百米處受推策。三百五十米處至二百米處之間空位不足。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, recovered to race in mid-division, shuffled back on bend, made up some ground home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。直路彎墮退。直路上略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, stuck to inside rail, under pressure over 300m out, unable to quicken, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，固守內欄。三百米處受催策，但未能加速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Began only fairly from the widest draw, raced in midfield but trapped wide, no cover throughout, dropped towards rear approaching 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。趨近五百米處時墮居後列。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) In rear, pushed along from top of home straight, some late headway, lacked pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居後列。自直路初起受推策。末段略為追前，但速度不足以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段走勢一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield, closed off fairly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般，對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back, same margin back on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，落後五個馬位，走外疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) In rear, still plenty to do 400m out, stayed on, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列。四百米處仍落後甚遠。保持走勢，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leader, weakened over 200m out.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處轉弱。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
(Jockey dropped whip at 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 居前列，走勢不俗。末段走勢平穩。
（於一百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Raced wide towards rear, pushed along entering home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat outside the lead, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Moderately away from gate 9, raced 3 wide behind midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 自第九檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Ridden early before gradually dropping to midfield or slightly worse 3-wide, made no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段受催策，其後逐漸墮居中間或中間稍後位置，走第三疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Held up, well held from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 留後。自直路初起落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail after sluggish start, baulked behind runners between the 500 and 250M, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內欄。五百米處至二百五十米處之間在馬群之後受困。其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress until no clear run final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，直至最後五十米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Raced keenly, ridden along to lead, gave ground and failed to respond over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 搶口，在催策下取得領先。末段墮退，對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Tracked pace, forced three wide final bend, pushed along, every chance until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎走第三疊。受推策，一度甚具爭勝機會，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide from 600M, challenged the leaders turning in, took the lead approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。入直路時挑戰領先馬匹。趨近二百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W2W) Shifted out shortly after start, 2nd in the early and middle stages, travelled keenly and lost position near 700M, raced slightly better than midfield on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 起步後不久向外斜跑。早段及中段居第二位，搶口。接近七百米處時失位。直路彎居中間稍前位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W3W3W) Away well, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader, peaked on turn, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W3W3W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位。直路彎未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W2W2W3W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, made steady progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W2W2W3W) 居前列，走勢良佳。在催策下穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen early, switched around winner 350m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。早段搶口。三百五十米處繞過頭馬。保持走勢，但未能增速以追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat on pace, switched out at the Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。直路彎向外移出。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W2W2W4W) Mid-division, very wide off final bend, good headway into contention 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時走大外疊。追前甚多，一百五十米處躋身爭勝行列。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled in forward of midfield 3-wide without cover, went slightly wider into straight, kept on under pressure until finding no extra 250M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時稍為移出更外疊。在催策下保持走勢，直至二百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Began smartly from a wide draw, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, 3 wide from 600M, commenced move 500M, very wide into straight, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 50M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上對催策反應良佳，五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢，但接近終點時不敵頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，落後約四個馬位，走外疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after passing 400M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。跑過四百米處後向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, found daylight near 200M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百米處時望空，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the outside, similar position on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back, there to turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Blundered after the start, settled towards the rear, 5Ls to make up 400M, stayed on steadily to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後失蹄，居後列。四百米處落後五個馬位。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Away with them, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, bumped near 500M, no clear run early in straight, made good progress final 200M to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。接近五百米處時發生碰撞。直路早段未能望空。最後二百米追前甚多，取得第四名。未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，碰撞對手，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, switched and driven along to chase leaders 500m out, ran on well and just lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線及受催策以追趕領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，僅失亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, taken wider on bend, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, on top from there, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出較外疊。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。其後帶返終點，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped fairly, settled further back than intended in second half of the field, raced 3-wide without cover before closing off mildly final 300M. Not reached leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘一般，居較預期為後的後半馬群之中，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米衝刺一般。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, restrained to race behind midfield, taken out to a 3-wide spot 600M, kept on steadily final 400M for 3rd but was no threat to the runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，受約束，居中間之後位置。六百米處向外移至第三疊。最後四百米保持穩勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅遙遙領先的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from 400m out, closed on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off well to take 2nd. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空。二百米處望空，衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W3W) Eased back to sit in a rearward position 7Ls off the fast pace, shuffled back to last spot making the home turn, brought wide to challenge and finished off mildly to take a non-threatening 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W3W) 收慢留居後列，落後步速甚快的領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時墮居包尾位置。移出外疊以展開挑戰。末段衝刺普通，取得第四名，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) From wide draw given a conservative ride at the rear, had plenty to make up 400M but failed to pick up pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。四百米處落後甚遠，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Restrained to race in second half of the field, travelled keenly, lost cover from 900M strode forward to chase leaders, run ended mid-straight and had no extra late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 受約束，居後半馬群中，跑來搶口。自九百米處起展步上前追趕領先馬匹，失去遮擋。直路中段無以為繼，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made some use take up a position outside the lead, failed to respond to riding in the home straight, weakened badly to finish tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 略受催策上前，佔取領放馬外側位置。直路上對催策毫無反應。末段嚴重轉弱，大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced keenly behind leaders, forward move to challenge 300m out, every chance, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領先馬匹之後，搶口。三百米處上前展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, travelled strongly to lead early in home straight, pressed on 250m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初走勢強勁，取得領先。二百五十米處受催策。一百米處被頭馬超越，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well, positioned 1 out 1 back, there to turn, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居第二疊第二位。直路彎前居相同位置，二百五十米處取得領先，末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away well to lead, set good pace in first half of the race, shifted away from running rail on straightening then kept on well only to be caught by first three in closing stages. (Riding tactics questioned.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，領放。前半程以快步速領放。入直路時移離內欄，其後保持佳勢，僅於末段被三甲馬匹超越。（騎師被查詢競跑策略。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, challenged the leader early in straight, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段挑戰領放馬。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Soon led, made all setting a sound pace, ridden clear over 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 瞬即帶頭，以快步速領放。二百米處在催策下帶離對手。
