runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Pressed forward to share early pace, obtained 1L advantage 1000M out, led until caught over 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前，早段並排領先。一千米處領先一個馬位。保持領先，直至一百米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W4W) Settled midfield, raced keenly in the early and middle stages, finished off ordinarily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置。早段及中段搶口。衝刺普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Box seat, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置，未能望空直至一百五十米處。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, headway between horses from 300m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。自三百米處起在馬匹之間追前。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out shortly after start and made contact, raced 2 wide better than midfield, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 250M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, checked at the 800M, took some time to respond in the Straight, made very good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。八百米處勒避。直路上需時對催策作出反應。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Slowly away, settled in mid-field, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置。直路初向外移出以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Soon prominent, pushed into lead 200m out, asserted and in control final 100m, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 瞬即居前列。受推策，二百米處取得領先。最後一百米控制大局，穩操勝券。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W4W) Crowded at start, raced very wide in rear, under pressure 600m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走大外疊。六百米處受催策。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時落後約四個馬位，末段衝刺良佳，取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow(-) (2W4W) On the back foot after badly squeezed shortly after the start, niggled throughout to stay attached, took a while to get into stride over final stages and won impressively from last.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速(-)(2W4W) 起步後不久嚴重受擠迫，居包尾位置。沿途在催策下跟隨馬群。末段加速需時，自包尾位置取勝，姿態出色。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, easy run to turn, showed good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, followed winner through top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米衝刺強勁，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, raced very wide throughout, detached in home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。沿途走大外疊。直路上被拋離。大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, 2 wide after passing 900M, still well back on turn, weakened early in straight, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走內疊。跑過九百米處後走第二疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路初轉弱。包尾大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position on bend, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置。二百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the inside, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走內疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策毫無反應，最後二百米轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Settled ahead of midfield, steadied when crowded near 900M then raced keenly for some distance, lacked a finishing response in the straight. Never a serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置。接近九百米處時在受擠迫之際收慢，其後在一段途程上搶口。直路上在催策下衝刺乏力。從未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Began only fairly, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, checked near 1200M, steadied off heels near 900M, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近千二米處時勒避。接近九百米處時收慢避開他駒後蹄。入直路時走大外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, sent forward to race prominently on the inside, took the lead near 1000M, shared lead with rival turning in, kept on well until headed 100M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走內疊。接近一千米處時取得領先，入直路時與對手並排領先。保持佳勢直至一百米處被超越，保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Three wide in mid-field, wide into home straight, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走外疊。末段保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well, taken back to race 3 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。三百米處望空，末段衝刺強勁，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on outer, no cover throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in rear top of home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Stayed in touch with leaders early stages when pace was very slow, drifted back to midfield halfway, wide on home turn, run ended mid-straight and weakened noticeably final stages. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹，步速非常緩慢。半程時墮居中間位置。直路彎走外疊。直路中段無以為繼。末段明顯轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Out with rest, settled 2 wide near the pace, showed good response early in the straight, not fully ridden out inside 100m due to rider's concern of the horse's action (See Incident Report).
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，靠近領放馬競跑，走第二疊。直路初對催策反應良佳。最後一百米因騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮而未受全力催策。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began awkwardly from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W4W) Slow to begin, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 600M, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W4W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Raced in rear after slowly away, wide into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，其後居後列。入直路時走外疊。未能望空直至三百米處。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W5W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced at rear on the outside, very wide into straight, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W5W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路初對催策反應平平，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 12, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened and eased final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三馬位。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Tracked pace, led 300m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處取得領先。二百米處被超越，其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield on the outside, moved closer on turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路彎追近。直路初取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，取得勝利。

formguide.comments_eng: Irish PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Invincible Spirit from Pie In The Sky, a daughter of Gleneagles. Horses by the same sire include Kolachi and Healthy Golf. This fellow had five starts in Britain for one win (a 2yo novice over 1200m on Polytrack) and one placing. This fellow was given six trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished ninth under slight pressure, beaten by 30-1/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on August 28. He's not looking like a first-up winner here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「志氣高」(Invincible Spirit)之後，在港同父馬包括「至高心得」及「健康高球」等駒，生母出自「教堂峽谷」(Gleneagles)。來港前於英國五戰得一勝一位，勝出一場為膠沙地1200米兩歲曾勝出0至2場賽。抵港後試閘六次。最近8月28日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第九名，落後頭馬30.25個馬位。不似能一出即勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled towards the rear, failed to respond from home turn and soon out of contention. Finished tailed out. (Jockey - failed to travel at any stage of the event / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。自直路彎起對催策毫無反應，瞬即再無爭勝機會。包尾大敗而回。（騎師表示，坐騎全程走勢欠佳。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From wide draw taken back to last, over 10Ls off the pace in middle stages, got left behind turning home. Soundly beaten. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。中段落後領放馬逾十個馬位。轉入直路時被拋離。大敗而回。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden to hold position from 500m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。自五百米處起受催策以保持位置。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, eased when detached 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。一百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Chased the leader one-off, weakened quickly near the 250M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走第二疊。接近二百五十米處時迅速轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Crowded shortly after start, towards rear, outpaced and left behind final bend, ran on well final 200m to made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。直路彎未能跟上步速，被拋離。最後二百米保持佳勢，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時被對手碰撞，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走勢輕鬆。直路早段未能望空，一百五十米處望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 躍出時發生碰撞，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。未能望空直至一百五十米處。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped on jumping, dropped back and settled near last, left behind by rivals turning in. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，墮居接近包尾位置。入直路時被對手拋離。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Chased leader on the inside after a clean start from draw 1, battled hard to stay in contention early straight, wasn't going as well as the leaders when checked 150 losing momentum.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘俐落，追趕領放馬，走內疊。直路初力拼以保持爭勝機會。一百五十米處勒避，失去步韻，走勢不及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Up with early pace before settling down 3-wide behind leaders without cover, responded well early straight to go 2nd nearing 200M but couldn't sustain run late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 早段跟上步速，其後居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路早段對催策反應良佳。接近二百米處時進佔第二位，但末段後勁不繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, sent forward to race in 2nd, challenged the leader from 600M, kept on well in straight but always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，受催策上前，居第二位。自六百米處起挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，但一直以些微距離落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W) Chased leaders along the fence, within striking distance turning home, responded well and dug deep final 200M to overhaul the long-time leader near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 沿欄追趕領先馬匹。入直路時落後領放馬不遠。最後二百米對催策反應良佳，持續力拼，接近終點時超越沿途帶頭的領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed near 250M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。接近二百五十米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再加速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Quickly away, soon in front and led uncontested to the straight, headed mid-straight then faded to finish 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，瞬即帶頭，單騎領放至直路。直路中段被超越，其後力竭，以第四名過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 13 showed customary pace to cross to the lead , became immediately under pressure when challenged by rival nearing 300M before giving ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十三檔出閘，展現一貫前速，切入領放。接近三百米處時受對手挑戰之際立即受催策，其後墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Stumbled shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on well in straight to hold off the challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久失蹄，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持佳勢，力拒對手挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, found rail after passing 600M, led by 1-1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。跑過六百米處後移入內欄。入直路時領先一又四分一馬位。二百米處未能再增速及被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Shifted in, bumped and lost balance out of stalls, raced in rear of mid-field, effort 500m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞及失去平衡。居中間之後位置。五百米處發力上前。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Chased leader, challenged and improved to lead top of home straight, soon headed by winner 250m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 追趕領放馬。直路初展開挑戰及上前取得領先。二百五十米處瞬即被頭馬超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven on bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) In last few to straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 直路前居最後數位之內。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, positioned 3 wide with cover, 2 to 3 lengths back, similar position on turn, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後兩至三個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Showed good speed to lead, headed 1000m out, chased leader into home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 展現甚快前速領放。一千米處被超越。入直路時追趕領放馬。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, moved forward chasing leaders, briefly went 2nd nearing 250M, lacked further response final 200M.
(Jockey dropped left rein for a number of strides passing 50M.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped left rein for a number of strides passing 50M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，上前追趕領先馬匹。接近二百五十米處時一度進佔第二位。最後二百米對催策再無反應。
（跑過五十米處時，騎師在數步間左邊韁繩脫手。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （跑過五十米處時，騎師在數步間左邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, failed to make any progress thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空，其後未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders against rail, travelled smoothly into home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時走勢暢順。三百米處轉換跑線以望空，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in 3rd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第三位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Ridden forward from the widest barrier to be 4-wide without cover in midfield, gave ground steadily final bend dropping to last over 200M out.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(5W3W4W) 自最外檔出閘，在催策下上前，居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎逐漸墮退。二百米處墮居包尾位置。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, angled off rail from 500m out, effort top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自五百米處起移離內欄。直路初發力。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W4W) Ridden along on rail in midfield in joint 6th, gained slightly closer before angling out for a run entering straight, sustained progress to hold every chance 150M out only to be denied close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W4W) 沿欄受催策，居中間位置，並列第六位。其後略為追近，入直路時向外移出取位。持續上前，一百五十米處一度甚具爭勝機會，僅於接近終點時落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well, gradually settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced without quickening under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，逐漸居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Driven along after the start but failed to show sufficient pace going forward, ended up racing behind mid-division, couldn't make up ground in the straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步後受催策，但未能展現足夠前速上前，居中間之後位置。直路上未能追前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, stayed on strongly, in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。保持勁勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) From draw 1 moved up to chase leaders, steadied 350M then closed off nicely to hit lead inside 100M, ran away late to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前追趕領先馬匹。三百五十米處收慢，其後衝刺良佳，一百米處取得領先。末段帶離對手，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, shared lead from 650M, hard ridden approaching 250M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。自六百五十米處起並排領先。趨近二百五十米處時受力策。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged and every chance from 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百五十米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。末段未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Bumped at the start then bustled along to take the lead from draw 11, soon pressed by rival on straightening, lost lead nearing 200M but kept battling to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 自第十一檔起步時發生碰撞，其後受催策，取得領先。入直路時瞬即受對手追迫。接近二百米處時失去領先位置，但持續力拼，保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, took the early lead, headed near 850M, 2nd on turn, retook the lead 300M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。接近八百五十米處時被超越。直路彎居第二位。三百米處重奪領先位置。保持甚佳走勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sent forward from wide draw and chased leader, tightened up briefly 500m out, ridden along behind leaders 300m out, stayed on to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，追趕領放馬。五百米處一度受緊迫。三百米處受催策，居領先馬匹之後。末段保持走勢，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Raced prominently, wandered under pressure from 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 居前列。自三百米處起在催策下走勢欠規矩。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well, raced prominently, took the lead 250M, kept on well, just able to hold off the challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，居前列。二百五十米處取得領先。其後保持佳勢，力拒對手的挑戰險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Stayed close to leaders, raced keenly in the middle stages when pace was steadied, briefly held up for clear running 400M but couldn't go on afterwards.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 保持緊隨領先馬匹。中段在步速減慢時搶口。四百米處一度受困而未能望空，但其後無以為繼。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from draw 1 and sat in 3rd, had difficulty obtaining clear running passing for some distance passing 250M but the finishing response was only when fair late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第三位。跑過二百五十米處時在一段途程上難以望空，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) From draw 1 stayed close enough to leaders, was repeatedly denied for clear running in the home straight before easing off final 150M when no chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘，保持緊隨領先馬匹。直路上一再未能望空。最後一百五十米在再無爭逐機會下收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Quickly into stride, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L on turn, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎領先四分三馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced prominently on the outside, took the lead near 1150M, found rail near 950M, led by a length turning in, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居前列，走外疊。接近一千一百五十米處時取得領先。接近九百五十米處切入內欄。入直路時領先一個馬位。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, gradually recovered along the rail to just over 1L back in 3rd, angled out for a run entering straight, found nothing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，逐漸恢復走勢，居第三位，落後稍逾一個馬位，走內欄。入直路時向外移出取位，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled ahead of midfield never far off from the pace, raced keenly in the middle stages, in 3rd spot passing 400M, fought hard but not going the pace of first two 200M, run ended close home dropped to 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，從未遠離領放馬。中段搶口。跑過四百米處時居第三位。力拼，但二百米處的加速力不及首兩名馬匹。接近終點時後繼無力，墮退至第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Raced in rear, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, settle 3Ls off leaders, couldn't quicken to challenge leaders final 300M. Never likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，落後領先馬匹三個馬位。最後三百米未能加速挑戰領先馬匹。從未看似有力爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Stayed within striking distance from leaders, briefly held up 250M but lacked a strong response in the final stages.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;保持落後領先馬匹不遠。二百五十米處一度受困，但末段對催策反應欠強勁。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, hung out and made contact near 900M, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。接近九百米處時外閃及發生觸踫。直路彎沿欄略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Well there, restrained to 3rd passing the 900M, did not find much room behind runners over 150M out, fought on well late to grab 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居好位，跑過九百米處時受約束，居第三位。一百五十米處在馬匹之後空位不足。末段以佳勢力拼，最後數步取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked leader against stand rail, pushed into lead over 150m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬，走外欄。一百五十米處受推策上前領放，走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast(+) Settled in front of midfield, switched in from 350M, made good progress when asked (Must BT).
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速(+)居中間之前位置。自三百五十米處起向內移入，在催策下追前頗多。（須試閘及格。）
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled well back, produced late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;遙居於後。末段略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, ran green in home straight, flattened out final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路上走勢稚嫩。最後二百米洩氣。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W3W) Settled down in second half of the field, closed off final 400M fastest to finish equal 3rd. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 居後半馬群中。最後四百米衝刺最快，取得平頭季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved ground, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。走內欄節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5-1/2L back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered towards rear in 9th on rail, commenced move leaving the 700M reaching within 3L of pace on rail into straight, ran on between runners to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，其後瞬即恢復走勢，居後列第九位，走內欄。跑離七百米處時開始上前。入直路時落後領放馬不逾三個馬位，走內欄。末段在馬匹之間上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Sat midfield, traveled smoothly, showed some dash over the concluding stages, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。末段略為加速，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。保持走勢，但末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well, taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Ridden along from stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, steadied for cover halfway out, bumped 350m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。半程時收慢以取得遮擋。三百五十米處發生碰撞。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W) Average to begin, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W) 出閘一般，落後領放馬五個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Soon dropped to midfield despite niggled at early, commenced move 400M out swinging one of the widest into straight, kept on until finding no extra inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 儘管於早段受催策，但瞬即墮居中間位置。四百米處開始上前。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。保持走勢，直至一百米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Ridden along from stalls to get across, challenged by winner early in home straight, headed 300m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 出閘後受催策，切入領放。直路初受頭馬挑戰。三百米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, responded nicely inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下取得領先，走勢暢順。最後二百米對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Drawn low and raced on outside towards center of track, in touch, stayed on well for pressure final 200m despite edging left towards leader.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自最內檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，靠近跑道中央競跑。最後二百米向著領放馬外閃，但在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Out with the rest and sat handy along the Grand Stands' rail 2 lengths behind the leader, held up briefly between 200m and 100m, hit the line strongly once a clear passage was found.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走外欄。二百米處至一百米處之間一度受困。望空後隨即以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, waited with towards rear, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched inside for clear run 200m out, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百米處移入內疊以望空。從未能加速以展開挑戰。
